description: Linux x86_64 Portal compatibility slice: SDL3 Wayland and linked DXVK Native D3D9 over Vulkan.

intent.support_scope: Native Linux Wayland compatibility smoke; not four-platform or renderer parity acceptance
intent.packaging: Waf-installed local Linux runtime with separately supplied licensed Portal content
intent.shader_pipeline: Existing Source D3D9 shader artifacts consumed by pinned DXVK Native; no new offline shader compiler is implied

required_checks: Installed Portal boot with required SDL3, Wayland and Vulkan evidence
Source architecture and changed-region style checks

evidence.note: Pins describe the selected reproducible host slice. Passing configure is not native graphics or product acceptance. Runtime evidence records actual GPU/driver, build/source identity, process results and artifacts separately. Performance/power budgets and other platform release gates remain open.
